steps.evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yaml:50 copies .env.ci (test config); for a dev instance the template is .env.example (also copied in Dockerfile:21)

.env.example:6,15-19 (APP_URL=http://panel.example.com, DB_PASSWORD blank for user 'pterodactyl'); must match the local DB. The external install docs do this via php artisan p:environment:setup / p:environment:database
APP_KEY empty in .env.example:3; the Docker entrypoint generates one (.github/docker/entrypoint.sh:18-23)
.env.example:17-18 (database 'panel', user 'pterodactyl'); MySQL/MariaDB only (ext-pdo_mysql in composer.json, CI matrix mariadb 10/11, mysql 8/9)
BUILDING.md:17-24 (yarn run build; without it the Panel returns a 500 about missing manifest.json; public/assets/manifest.json is gitignored)
.github/docker/README.md:17-24 ('After the startup is complete you'll need to create a user'; no self-registration)

optionalSteps.evidence: .github/docker/entrypoint.sh:92 runs migrate with --seed (nests/eggs; needed to create game servers, not to start the panel)

notes: The README has no setup commands; it links to external docs (pterodactyl.io panel getting_started, not read) and to the separate pterodactyl/development environment that BUILDING.md 'highly recommends'. In-repo docs cover only frontend assets (BUILDING.md); the PHP-side steps come from CI, the production Docker entrypoint/README and Laravel conventions, so most are tagged convention. No in-repo doc names a PHP dev server: 'php artisan serve' is the Laravel default, while production uses nginx/php-fpm. Redis: .env.example sets QUEUE_CONNECTION=redis (config/queue.php default is redis) and .github/docker/README.md calls a cache 'required'; switching QUEUE_CONNECTION to sync would avoid it. Node version disagreement: BUILDING.md says Node v14 + Yarn 1 (stale), flake.nix/shell.nix use nodejs_18, package.json engines '>=22' and CI/Dockerfile use Node 22. BUILDING.md also lists Go 1.17, but only for Wings (a separate repo), so it is omitted. The yarn serve (HMR) script is hard-wired to https://pterodactyl.test:5173 and local certs, so 'yarn run watch' is the practical dev command. This checkout is the 1.0-develop branch; README says v2 development happens on 2.0-develop.
